{"code": "import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv', parse_dates=['date'])
a = df[df.account_id=='YxSxqn0'].copy()
# scan every combo for weekday baseline vs Oct13+ weekday change in num_instances and price
g = a.groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family'])
res=[]
for k,sub in g:
    sub=sub.copy(); sub['wd']=sub.date.dt.day_of_week<5
    base_wd = sub[(sub.wd)&(sub.date<pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13'))]
    post_wd = sub[(sub.wd)&(sub.date>=pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13'))]
    if len(post_wd)==0: continue
    res.append((k, base_wd.num_instances.mean(), post_wd.num_instances.mean(), base_wd.price.mean(), post_wd.price.mean(), base_wd.unblended_cost.mean(), post_wd.unblended_cost.mean()))
r=pd.DataFrame(res, columns=['key','ni_base','ni_post','p_base','p_post','c_base','c_post']).set_index('key')
r['dcost']=(r.c_post-r.c_base).round(1)
print(r.sort_values('dcost',ascending=False).head(8).round(2).to_string())"}
